headline: Advance Agrolife receives show cause-cum-demand notice from GST department
summary: Advance Agrolife Limited informed stock exchanges that it has received a Show Cause-cum-Demand Notice from the GST Department. The disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations regarding litigation and disputes. Specific financial amounts and details of the tax demand were not disclosed in the filing. Retail investors holding the stock should watch for subsequent company disclosures regarding the financial impact.
whats_next: Company clarification on GST demand amount
why_it_matters: Tax disputes could pose short-term cash flow or legal risks.
